entity.name: Eduard Izgorodin
entity.description: Independent researcher and engineer building open memory infrastructure for AI agents. Author of Semantic Level of Detail (SLoD, arXiv:2603.08965). Based in Funchal, Portugal.

projects.name: Mnemoverse MCP Memory Server
projects.description: An MCP server that gives AI agents persistent long-term memory through one key, across Claude, Cursor, VS Code and other MCP clients. Published in the Official MCP Registry. Proxies the Mnemoverse memory engine: memory atoms connected by a weighted graph, with server-stamped provenance and DB-enforced isolation.

projects.name: Mnemoverse Python SDK
projects.description: Python client for the Mnemoverse memory API: write, read, and give feedback on agent memory from any Python program.

channels.description: Contact to arrange funding; direct transfer or platform to be agreed.

plans.name: Maintain and grow the open memory tooling
plans.description: One maintainer plus hosting and CI to keep the MCP memory server and Python SDK healthy, documented, and usable across MCP clients, and to keep the honest-evaluation and provenance work open.
